segments.ZEC.1.1-3: The LORD tells Zechariah to call the people to return

segments.ZEC.1.20-21: Four craftsmen come to throw down the horns

segments.ZEC.3.6-7: The LORD promises Joshua authority if he obeys

segments.ZEC.5.8-9: The woman Wickedness is shut in the basket
segments.ZEC.5.10-11: Two women carry the basket to build a house in Shinar
segments.ZEC.6.1-4: Zechariah sees four chariots between two mountains
segments.ZEC.6.5-6: The angel tells Zechariah where the chariots go
segments.ZEC.6.7-8: The LORD sends the horses to patrol the earth
segments.ZEC.6.9-11: God tells Zechariah to make a crown for Joshua
segments.ZEC.6.12-13: The Branch will build the LORD’s temple and rule
segments.ZEC.7.1-3: Men from Bethel ask whether to keep fasting
segments.ZEC.7.4-7: The LORD asks if the people fasted for him
segments.ZEC.7.8-10: The LORD tells the people to be just and kind
segments.ZEC.7.11-12: The people refused to listen, so the LORD was angry
segments.ZEC.7.13-14: The LORD scatters the people who would not listen
segments.ZEC.8.1-3: The LORD will return to Zion and live in Jerusalem

segments.ZEC.8.23-23: Ten men from the nations will want to go with a Jew

segments.ZEC.9.5-7: The LORD will humble the Philistine cities

segments.ZEC.9.11-13: The LORD will free the prisoners and make Judah strong
segments.ZEC.9.14-15: The LORD will appear and shield his people in battle
segments.ZEC.9.16-17: The LORD will save his people like a flock

segments.ZEC.10.4-5: Judah will produce strong rulers who win in battle

segments.ZEC.11.17-17: The LORD declares judgment on the worthless shepherd

segments.ZEC.12.12-14: Every clan in the land will mourn on its own

segments.ZEC.13.8-9: The LORD will refine the remaining third of the people

segments.ZEC.14.5-5: The people will flee through the valley as the LORD comes
segments.ZEC.14.6-8: Living water will flow out from Jerusalem
